text:
Arya: quick dump from today's lab: two-phase soft-reserve prototype behaved oddly at scale
Sam: what happened?
Arya: p95 improved for some tenants but overall soft_promote_rate was only ~30% and memory rose ~7%
Lee: low promote rate means many prefetches wasted -> KV pressure
Priya: did we track which clients caused most cancels? mobile vs server?
Arya: yes — mobile clients with high RTT produced most timeouts; they often arrived too late to coalesce
Nina: idea: make tentative timeout adaptive to client RTT and a short sequence-length predictor
Sam: adaptive timeout could help but complicates fairness; tenants could spoof RTT header
Priya: trust but verify — use observed RTT in trace rather than client-supplied hint for gating decisions
Lee: fairness accounting question: should tentative slots be invisible to the global fair-share ledger?
Arya: proposal: keep tentative slots out of hard ledger, but record fractional soft_credit = beta on successful promote; beta decays for repeated soft-only attempts
Nina: that matches our anti-gaming goal. also cap concurrent tentatives per-tenant (N_soft) and enforce global soft quota
Sam: eviction behavior: we saw spike in ephemeral_kv entries causing eviction churn when tentatives cancel
Priya: mitigation: mark ephemeral entries as low-priority with TTL and avoid treating them as strong eviction signals
Lee: also apply eviction_backoff: repeat evictees get lower N_soft for a cooldown window, exponential backoff on repeated evictions
Arya: rollout plan: feature-flag two_phase_soft=true, canary two shards for 48h, conservative defaults: N_soft=2, T_base=30ms, beta=0.5
Sam: success metrics: soft_promote_rate>0.5 AND p95_reduction_on_target_tenants>=25ms AND mem_delta<10%
Nina: add telemetry: tentative_issued, tentative_canceled, tentative_promoted, soft_credit_balance_per_tenant, ephemeral_kv_bytes, eviction_backoff_factor
Priya: add traces: reservation_id -> batch_id -> eviction_id to debug race windows
orchestrator-bot: canary deploy scheduled: shard-b with feature two_phase_soft=false (flag off)
Arya: I'll write RFC with state machine, fairness math (beta schedule), and rollout checklist. ping me for reviews
Sam: please include an anti-spam section and the conservative safe-mode when coord shard unavailable
Lee: long-term: replace static heuristics with a learned coalesce predictor service and move N_soft enforcement to a light coord service
Priya: noted. I'll stub dashboards and alerts for rollback triggers. good session :thumbsup:
